description: Fix one buggy function in each of 24 modules until the suite passes. The correct behavior lives ONLY in each module's BEHAVIOR REFERENCE docstring (the test pins outputs with a one-way digest, so nothing can be copied from it), and every module has distinct logic + unique constants — forcing the agent to read all 24 references, which bloats context past 100k.
note: Load-bearing successor to debug-hugelib: property-based + digest-pinned tests leak no answers, so the reference docstrings are the only source of behavior. Confirm it crosses 100k with one continue pilot before the full matrix.
